verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The design now explicitly preserves string-literal graph expressions, ties their acceptance to the existing str-to-NamedNode coercion, and requires a positive generator/runtime witness so the compile-time filter is acceptance-preserving. It retains generation-time rejection only for syntactic forms that necessarily produce out-of-space values, while the closed GraphName representation and fallible emission-time conversion cover erased production calls and bindings. The negative, positive, runtime-error, and default-graph tests exercise the stated invariants rather than merely matching generated text. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is apparent in the diff.
